mapper.sql: r.id AS reservation_id, r.member_id, r.trainer_id, r.customer_name, r.customer_phone, r.reservation_type, r.status AS reservation_status, r.starts_at, r.ends_at, r.memo
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(reservation_type = 'CONSULTATION'), 0) AS consultation_count, COALESCE(SUM(reservation_type = 'TRIAL_PT'), 0) AS trial_pt_count, COALESCE(SUM(reservation_type = 'REGULAR_PT'), 0) AS regular_pt_count, COALESCE(SUM(status IN ('CANCELLED', 'NO_SHOW')), 0) AS cancelled_or_no_show_count, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'PENDING'), 0) AS pending_count FROM reservations WHERE starts_at >= #{date} AND starts_at < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT m.id AS option_id, m.name AS option_name, m.phone AS option_description FROM members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND (m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY m.name, m.id LIMIT 30

SELECT t.id AS option_id, t.name AS option_name, COALESCE(t.specialty, '전문 분야 미등록') AS option_description FROM trainers t JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id WHERE t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY t.name, t.id
SELECT m.id AS option_id, m.name AS option_name, m.phone AS option_description FROM members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.id = #{memberId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT t.id FROM trainers t JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id WHERE t.id = #{trainerId} AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE reservations SET member_id = #{memberId}, trainer_id = #{trainerId}, customer_name = #{customerName}, customer_phone = #{customerPhone}, reservation_type = #{reservationType}, starts_at = #{startsAt}, ends_at = #{endsAt}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{reservationId} AND status = #{status}
